name: Lattice Emitter
description: A Nova hand device that projects a lattice of light shaped like its user.
role: A weapon of deception, not force: it fields a decoy while its user moves.

artBrief.silhouette: Short rod with a ring at its tip.
artBrief.detail: White body, Nova blue ring and a faint lattice pattern along the rod.
artBrief.spriteScale: Held by a 2×2 cell character; drawn over its skin.
requiredVariants: 8 directions, each with idle and walk frames (the Object Layer direction set)
